title: 快速开始
text: Quick start One goal: prove that key + model ID + route all work. 1 Sign up and top up on the main site. 2 Create a key and pick the right group. 3 Copy a model ID from the recommended models table or /v1/models below. 4 Send a minimal request; configure clients only after it succeeds. List models bash Copy curl https://api.daoxe.com/v1/models \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx" Minimal Chat bash Copy curl https://api.daoxe.com/v1/chat/completions \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -N \ -d '{ "model": "copy from /v1/models", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"ping"}], "max_tokens": 64 }' Minimal Messages (if using Claude) bash Copy curl https://api.daoxe.com/v1/messages \ -H "x-api-key: sk-xxxx" \ -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "copy from /v1/models", "max_tokens": 64, "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"ping"}] }' Route switching and Base URL shapes: Routes / Protocols . On failure, check common errors .

title: 模型与分组
text: Models & groups Three linked concepts: a key belongs to a group, the group decides models and ratios, the model ID picks the model. Group : chosen at key creation; decides which models the key can call and at what ratio. Tell two permission errors apart: the token has no access to the model → 403 (check the token's model allow-list / permissions); the chosen group has no available channel for the model → 503 / no available channel (switch to a group that includes the model, or confirm it has an available channel in the current group) Model ID : must match the site exactly (case and suffix). Copy from the recommended models table or /v1/models Protocol endpoint : one model may serve several protocols (Chat / Responses / Messages) — see the live table below Syncing live data… Curated sample & search: recommended models table . Create a key: create a key .

title: DeepChat（官方内置）
text: DeepChat DaoXE ships inside DeepChat as a built-in provider: search, toggle on, paste a key — no Base URL to configure. Prerequisites Signed in with balance · key created in the right group ( create a key ) · model IDs from the models table or /v1/models Built-in provider DaoXE ships in this client's official build with a pinned Base URL — there's nothing to fill in besides your API key. Download & install Download the desktop client from deepchat.dev (Windows / macOS / Linux). DaoXE is an official built-in provider — no custom setup needed. Setup steps 1 Settings → Provider Center , search daoxe and toggle DaoXE on. 2 On the Connect tab the API URL is pinned to the recommended Base (don't change it) — just paste your API Key ( sk-xxxx ). 3 Click Verify key to confirm connectivity, then Refresh models to pull the site's model list. 4 Switch to the Models tab, enable the models you want, and start chatting. Choosing models Model IDs must match the site exactly (case-sensitive). Copy them from the recommended models table or GET /v1/models . If the key's group doesn't include the model you'll get 403 / model not available — see Models & groups . Common pitfalls «0 models enabled» is the initial state: after pasting the key and refreshing, remember to tick models on the Models tab. If verification fails, check the key and its group ( create a key ) — the Base URL is built-in and can't be the problem. title: Claude Code
text: Claude Code Anthropic Messages. Base is the site root. Prerequisites Signed in with balance · key created in the right group ( create a key ) · model IDs from the models table or /v1/models Protocol details: protocol checklist . Get Messages working first: bash Copy curl https://api.daoxe.com/v1/messages \ -H "x-api-key: sk-xxxx" \ -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "copy from /v1/models", "max_tokens": 64, "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"ping"}] }' Environment variables / settings bash Copy export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.daoxe.com" export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-xxxx" json Copy { "env": { "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "https://api.daoxe.com", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "sk-xxxx" } } Directory: ~/.claude . Verify with claude . If curl works but the CLI fails: check for a stray /v1 or overriding env vars. Original doc: CLAUDE_CODE.md . Prefer a GUI? See CC Switch .

title: CC Switch 图形配置
text: CC Switch (GUI) Manage Claude Code / Codex provider configs with the CC Switch GUI — switch with one click, no file edits. Who this is for Desktop users who'd rather not hand-edit settings.json / config.toml , or who switch between providers often. Manual setup: Claude Code and Codex CLI . Download & install Download from cc-switch Releases . Windows: .msi ; macOS: brew install --cask cc-switch ; Linux desktop: .deb / .rpm / AppImage. Setup steps 1 Switch to the target app (Claude / Codex icon) at the top, click the «+» button to add a provider. 2 Fill the form: any name (e.g. DaoXE ); request URL depends on the protocol — Claude Code takes the site root https://api.daoxe.com (Claude-compatible endpoint, no trailing slash ); Codex takes https://api.daoxe.com/v1 ; API Key = sk-xxxx . 3 Leave advanced options / config JSON at defaults and click «Add». 4 Click «Enable» on the new entry — it only takes effect once marked as in use. 5 Verify in a fresh terminal with claude or codex ; if it fails, curl first. Click to enlarge CC Switch main window · «+» adds a provider · Click image to enlarge Click to enlarge Add-provider form · request URL is the Claude-compatible site root, no trailing slash · Click image to enlarge Click to enlarge After enabling, the entry shows as in use · Click image to enlarge Common pitfalls No trailing / in the request URL; Claude and Codex use different bases (root vs /v1 ) — don't mix them up. Forgetting to click «Enable» after adding is the top issue — the entry must show as in use. Open a new terminal after switching; old sessions keep the old config. Related Claude Code Codex CLI curl check

title: Codex CLI
text: Codex CLI OpenAI /v1 + responses. Prerequisites Signed in with balance · key created in the right group ( create a key ) · model IDs from the models table or /v1/models bash Copy export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-xxxx" export OPENAI_BASE_URL="https://api.daoxe.com/v1" codex toml Copy model_provider = "daoxe" [model_providers.daoxe] name = "DaoXE" base_url = "https://api.daoxe.com/v1" wire_api = "responses" requires_openai_auth = true json Copy { "OPENAI_API_KEY": "sk-xxxx" } /v1 is required See the protocol checklist · Responses

title: Gemini CLI
text: Gemini CLI Google's official terminal agent. Two environment variables route it through the site's Gemini-compatible endpoint. Prerequisites Signed in with balance · key created in the right group ( create a key ) · model IDs from the models table or /v1/models 全球优化 https://api.daoxe.com 默认 https://daoxe.com 直连 https://jp.daoxe.com Download & install Requires Node.js 20+: npm install -g @google/gemini-cli , then run gemini . Setup steps 1 Create a key in a group that includes Gemini models (see Create a key ). 2 Export GEMINI_API_KEY=sk-xxxx and GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL=https://api.daoxe.com (site root, no /v1 or /v1beta ). 3 Open a new terminal, run gemini , pick «Use Gemini API key» as the auth method; select a site Gemini model with -m <model-id> . bash Copy # ~/.zshrc / ~/.bashrc export GEMINI_API_KEY="sk-xxxx" export GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL="https://api.daoxe.com" gemini -m 你的Gemini模型ID bash Copy # 先用 curl 验证 Gemini 兼容端点 / smoke-test the Gemini endpoint first curl "https://api.daoxe.com/v1beta/models/你的Gemini模型ID:generateContent?key=sk-xxxx" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"contents":[{"parts":[{"text":"ping"}]}]}' Choosing models Only Gemini-family models are served on /v1beta ; copy IDs (the gemini-* series) from the recommended models table . Common pitfalls Base must be the site root https://api.daoxe.com : the CLI appends /v1beta/... itself, so an extra /v1 gives 404. Environment variables only apply to new shells — reopen the terminal before running gemini . Gemini models also work through OpenAI-protocol tools (Base https://api.daoxe.com/v1 ) — see the protocol checklist . title: Cherry Studio
text: Cherry Studio Open-source desktop client (Win / macOS / Linux). Add an OpenAI-type provider to connect. Prerequisites Signed in with balance · key created in the right group ( create a key ) · model IDs from the models table or /v1/models 全球优化 https://api.daoxe.com 默认 https://daoxe.com 直连 https://jp.daoxe.com Download & install Download from cherry-ai.com or GitHub Releases (CherryHQ/cherry-studio). All three desktop platforms are supported. Setup steps 1 Open Settings → Model Services, click Add at the bottom and pick provider type OpenAI . 2 Set API address to https://api.daoxe.com . Cherry Studio appends /v1 automatically; a trailing / disables the append, a trailing # forces the URL as-is. 3 Paste your sk-xxxx key into the API key field. 4 In the provider's Models section click Add and type the model ID manually (the dropdown won't list it automatically). 5 Hit Check to run a connectivity test, then pick the model in a chat. Choosing models Model IDs must match the site exactly (case-sensitive). Copy them from the recommended models table or GET /v1/models . If the key's group doesn't include the model you'll get 403 / model not available — see Models & groups . Common pitfalls The trailing-slash rule is the top gotcha: entering https://api.daoxe.com/v1 and letting the app append again yields /v1/v1 → 404. Just use https://api.daoxe.com . For translation / quick actions, switch to a cheap fast model to avoid burning quota or hitting 429 rate limits. title: ChatBox
text: ChatBox Cross-platform chat client (desktop + mobile + web). Connect via a custom OpenAI-compatible provider. Prerequisites Signed in with balance · key created in the right group ( create a key ) · model IDs from the models table or /v1/models 全球优化 https://api.daoxe.com 默认 https://daoxe.com 直连 https://jp.daoxe.com Download & install Download from chatboxai.app (Windows / macOS / Linux / iOS / Android, plus a web version). Setup steps 1 Settings → Model Provider → Add Custom Provider , choose mode OpenAI API Compatible . 2 API Host = https://api.daoxe.com , keep the default API path /v1/chat/completions (older builds with a single host field: use https://api.daoxe.com/v1 ). 3 Paste your sk-xxxx key, type the model ID under Model and save. 4 Back in a chat, switch the provider selector to the new entry and send a test message. Choosing models Model IDs must match the site exactly (case-sensitive). Copy them from the recommended models table or GET /v1/models . If the key's group doesn't include the model you'll get 403 / model not available — see Models & groups . Common pitfalls Don't put /v1 in both host and path — /v1/v1/chat/completions is a 404. An empty model dropdown is expected: custom providers require typing the model ID by hand. title: Lobe Chat
text: Lobe Chat Open-source web chat framework (self-hostable). Point the OpenAI provider's proxy URL at the site. Prerequisites Signed in with balance · key created in the right group ( create a key ) · model IDs from the models table or /v1/models 全球优化 https://api.daoxe.com/v1 默认 https://daoxe.com/v1 直连 https://jp.daoxe.com/v1 Download & install Hosted at lobehub.com , or self-host via Docker / Vercel (repo lobehub/lobe-chat). Setup steps 1 Settings → AI Provider → OpenAI . 2 API Key = sk-xxxx ; API proxy URL = https://api.daoxe.com/v1 (the /v1 suffix is required). 3 Enable client-side request mode so calls go straight from the browser instead of Lobe's server. 4 Fetch the model list automatically or add model IDs manually, then run the connectivity check. Choosing models Model IDs must match the site exactly (case-sensitive). Copy them from the recommended models table or GET /v1/models . If the key's group doesn't include the model you'll get 403 / model not available — see Models & groups . Common pitfalls Forgetting /v1 in the proxy URL is the most common mistake — symptoms are 404 / Connection failed . The hosted version may fail to reach custom endpoints through its server relay; client-side request mode fixes this. UI reference Click to enlarge Lobe Chat · OpenAI provider settings · Click image to enlarge Related Protocols curl check Errors

title: NextChat
text: NextChat Lightweight web / desktop client (formerly ChatGPT-Next-Web). Connect via custom endpoint + custom model names. Prerequisites Signed in with balance · key created in the right group ( create a key ) · model IDs from the models table or /v1/models 全球优化 https://api.daoxe.com 默认 https://daoxe.com 直连 https://jp.daoxe.com Download & install Site: nextchat.club . Desktop builds are on GitHub Releases (ChatGPTNextWeb/NextChat); self-deploy is one click. Setup steps 1 Settings → enable Custom Endpoint . 2 Endpoint = https://api.daoxe.com ( no /v1 — NextChat appends the path itself); API Key = sk-xxxx . 3 Put site model IDs into Custom Models (comma separated; prefix + appends, e.g. +model-id ), then pick them in the model dropdown. Choosing models Model IDs must match the site exactly (case-sensitive). Copy them from the recommended models table or GET /v1/models . If the key's group doesn't include the model you'll get 403 / model not available — see Models & groups . Common pitfalls Adding /v1 to the endpoint produces /v1/v1/... → 404. Use plain https://api.daoxe.com . The dropdown only lists official OpenAI names by default; site models must be added via Custom Models first. title: Open WebUI
text: Open WebUI Self-hosted web UI (Docker). Add one OpenAI API connection under External Connections for all users. Prerequisites Signed in with balance · key created in the right group ( create a key ) · model IDs from the models table or /v1/models 全球优化 https://api.daoxe.com/v1 默认 https://daoxe.com/v1 直连 https://jp.daoxe.com/v1 Download & install Site: openwebui.com . Typically deployed with one Docker command (repo open-webui/open-webui). Setup steps 1 Admin Panel → Settings → Connections . 2 Under OpenAI API click «+»: URL = https://api.daoxe.com/v1 , Key = sk-xxxx , save. 3 Open WebUI then calls /v1/models automatically and every site model appears in the model selector. 4 Optionally hide unused models under Admin Panel → Models to keep the selector short. Choosing models Model IDs must match the site exactly (case-sensitive). Copy them from the recommended models table or GET /v1/models . If the key's group doesn't include the model you'll get 403 / model not available — see Models & groups . Common pitfalls The URL must include /v1 ; without it the model list fetch fails outright. Inside Docker the container can't reach a proxy on the host's «localhost»; use the public site URL directly. title: 沉浸式翻译
text: Immersive Translate Browser translation extension. Point its OpenAI service at a custom endpoint to translate pages with site models. Prerequisites Signed in with balance · key created in the right group ( create a key ) · model IDs from the models table or /v1/models 全球优化 https://api.daoxe.com/v1 默认 https://daoxe.com/v1 直连 https://jp.daoxe.com/v1 Download & install Install from your browser's extension store or from immersivetranslate.com . Setup steps 1 Extension settings → Translation Services → OpenAI , APIKEY = sk-xxxx . 2 Expand advanced options and set the custom API endpoint to https://api.daoxe.com/v1/chat/completions (full path). 3 Choose custom model and enter a cheap fast site model ID (translation volume is high, so optimize for cost). 4 Lower max requests per second (e.g. 5–10) so full-page translation doesn't trip 429 rate limits. Choosing models Model IDs must match the site exactly (case-sensitive). Copy them from the recommended models table or GET /v1/models . If the key's group doesn't include the model you'll get 403 / model not available — see Models & groups . Common pitfalls The endpoint needs the full /chat/completions path; stopping at /v1 errors on some versions. Frequent 429s: lower concurrency first, then see rate limits . Don't copy sample names from docs/blogs. python Copy from openai import OpenAI client = OpenAI(api_key="sk-xxxx", base_url="https://api.daoxe.com/v1") print(client.chat.completions.create( model="your-model-id", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}], max_tokens=64, ).choices[0].message.content) js Copy import OpenAI from "openai"; const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: "sk-xxxx", baseURL: "https://api.daoxe.com/v1" }); const r = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: "your-model-id", messages: [{ role: "user", content: "ping" }], max_tokens: 64, }); console.log(r.choices[0].message.content); python Copy import anthropic client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key="sk-xxxx", base_url="https://api.daoxe.com") msg = client.messages.create( model="your-claude-model-id", max_tokens=64, messages=[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}], ) print(msg.content[0].text) Runnable repo: DaoXE-AI . title: 双协议接入清单
text: Protocol checklist The single authoritative protocol mapping; client chapters only link here. Available routes and hosts are maintained in Routes & Base URL ; hosts in the table follow live api_info. Protocol mapping Protocol Base URL to use Typical path OpenAI Chat https://api.daoxe.com/v1 /v1/chat/completions OpenAI Responses https://api.daoxe.com/v1 /v1/responses Anthropic Messages https://api.daoxe.com (site root; swap the host for other routes) /v1/messages Showing built-in default routes (live API unavailable); swap the host to switch routes. Smoke-test before configuring Before configuring any client, run a minimal Chat / Messages request with curl to confirm the key and route work: curl verification . Client mapping Cline / Cursor → OpenAI Compatible (Base with /v1 ) Claude Code → site root + Messages Codex → /v1 + responses Symptoms when swapped Extra /v1 on a Claude Base → /v1/v1/messages Missing /v1 on an OpenAI client → 404 Token has no access to the model → 403 ; no available channel for the model in the chosen group → 503 / no available channel

Compare with the jp route bash Copy curl https://jp.daoxe.com/v1/models \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx" Tips Add -N to reduce buffering; -i to see the status line. Repo script: curl-chat.sh . title: 限流与重试
text: Rate limits & retries A 429 (Rate limit exceeded) means you hit a rate or concurrency limit — shed load and retry as below. Recommendations Lower concurrency and retry frequency; don't hammer one model Exponential backoff (1s → 2s → 4s) with random jitter so retries don't align Reduce simultaneous long-lived streaming connections Backoff retry example python Copy import random, time for attempt in range(5): resp = call_api() # your request function if resp.status_code != 429: break delay = 2 ** attempt + random.random() # 1s -> 2s -> 4s... + jitter time.sleep(delay) Related Common errors Error samples

title: 计费规则
text: Billing rules Three billing factors: model unit price × group ratio × usage. Ratios come from the pricing API; usage logs are the ground truth. Billing modes Usage-based : input / output tokens priced separately — output is usually more expensive (see the completion ratio in the marketplace). Per-call : some models charge a fixed price per call regardless of tokens. Group ratio : final price = base price × group_ratio (table below). Pre-hold & settle : streaming requests hold quota first and settle to actual usage afterwards — brief balance jumps in the logs are normal. Live ratios & endpoints Syncing live data… Live model prices: recommended models table . Reconciliation: balance & logs .

title: 充值对账
text: Top-up reconciliation Payment shows success but the balance didn't move — handle it in this order. 1 Confirm success on the payment channel; save the order number / screenshot 2 Confirm the signed-in account matches the one that ordered 3 Wait 15–30 minutes 4 Still nothing: don't place more orders — contact support Common causes Payment-channel callback delay (common with crypto, cross-border or third-party payment peaks) Ordered and signed in on different accounts (switched email or OAuth provider) Amount or plan doesn't match the page, or a redeem code wasn't submitted in “Wallet” Related Top-up & plans Balance & logs Contact support

title: 密钥管理
text: Key management Day-to-day key hygiene: splitting, rotation, leak handling. Creation steps live in “Create an API key”. Splitting advice One purpose, one key : separate keys for local dev, CI and production minimize blast radius One group, one key : groups decide models and ratios; mixing causes “model unavailable / unexpected charges” Set quotas or expiry on keys (as the console offers) as insurance for temporary uses Leak handling 1 Delete the key in the console immediately (revocation is instant). 2 Create a new key and update every client / env var using it. 3 Check usage logs for abnormal calls during the leak window. Never commit to Git A leaked sk- key in a public repo gets exploited by scanners within seconds. Use env vars or a secret manager. Related Create an API key Auth & headers

title: 网络与访问
text: Network & access The website being unreachable doesn't mean the API is down — they use different entry points; debug them separately. Debug order 1 Test the API first: curl verification across the route hosts in turn (api → main site → jp). If any works, carry on. 2 Then test the web page: another browser / private window / network. If only the page is slow, API calls are unaffected. 3 Check local proxy and DNS: proxy rules may only allow some domains — allow every route host. 4 Nothing works: contact support with the time, region, network type and error screenshots. Symptom table Symptom Diagnosis Page unreachable, curl works The web entry is affected by your network; the API is fine — keep calling One route times out, others work Just swap the Base URL host (one config change in your client) No route connects at all Check local network / proxy first, then ask support about service status Service region restrictions: account & compliance .
